subject.title: BL-pricing-offers-07: first-hand reference drops shipping before cascade

question: Should first-hand reference pricing use item-plus-shipping as the canonical basis for `priceNew`, `firstHandMinPrice`, and the `MIN_1_HAND` cascade?
rationale: Current source reproduces the inconsistency, but historical PR context shows `priceNew` without shipping was once intentional, so maintainer intent is required before a price-changing fix lands.

options.title: Use total first-hand price
options.body: Preserve shipping by basing `priceNew`, `firstHandMinPrice`, and the cascade reference on `totalPrice`, ideally without mutating the saved offer snapshot.

options.title: Keep item-only `priceNew`
options.body: Document that `priceNew` intentionally excludes shipping and adjust the cascade/reference fields so comparisons are explicit rather than accidentally mixed.

options.title: Defer until BL extraction merges
options.body: Wait for the Offer Pricing refactor to land, then apply the confirmed pricing-basis decision in the extracted service with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Use total first-hand price
recommendation.body: Preserve shipping by basing `priceNew`, `firstHandMinPrice`, and the cascade reference on `totalPrice`, ideally without mutating the saved offer snapshot.
